checks.label: The charger voltage is the float volts per cell times the number of cells: at 2.23 V a cell, 6 cells need 13.38 V, 12 need 26.76 V, 24 need 53.52 V and 55 need 122.65 V
Large stationary batteries at 25 °C typically float at 2.25 V a cell: the charge ends on float at 2.25 V a cell, and 12 cells there need 27.00 V
The charge voltage drops 3 mV a cell for every degree above 25 °C and rises 3 mV for every degree below: 2.25 V becomes 2.22 V at 35 °C and 2.28 V at 15 °C, and 24 cells go from 54.00 V to 53.28 V
Full charge is reached when the current falls to 3 to 5 per cent of the Ah rating: on 100 Ah the charger drops to float as the topping current reaches 4 A, inside the drawn 3 to 5 A band

To cut the recharge time a battery may be recharged at 2.33 to 2.40 V a cell, and must switch to float when full: the 2.38 V boost reaches full before a charge at the float setting, then drops to 2.25 V
An equalising charge raises the voltage to 2.50 V a cell: the equalise stretch holds 2.50 V a cell, and 24 cells need 60.00 V
The gassing voltage is 2.40 V a cell: bubbles rise at 2.40 V a cell and above, never at the 2.38 V boost or on float
A charged, rested cell reads 2.1 V and the nominal voltage is 2 V a cell: 55 cells give 115.50 V and 110.00 V, both below the 122.65 V float setting

Full charge avoids sulfation on the negative plate, and over-saturation causes grid corrosion on the positive plate: below the float band only the sulphate meter rises, above it only the grid meter, and inside it neither
Bulk holds 10 A while the volts per cell climb, topping holds the charge setting while the current falls, and float holds 2.25 V with a small current
51.60 V across 24 cells is 2.15 V a cell, below the float band, so a year there grows sulphate and no corrosion; boost at 2.40 V on 24 cells is 57.60 V
Each puzzle accepts only its right answer, and nothing in its picture gives the answer before Check
Thirteen screens: demonstrations and puzzles take turns, then two mixed puzzles end the lesson
Every demonstration settles within 4.6 s and ends where its screen says, every answer's motion settles within 2.5 s, and a spell of months takes 2 s
